parent_fit.reason: User story is the root of the V; no parent to trace to.

single_user_capability.reason: One capability: safety at the passenger doors when boarding and leaving.

user_observable.reason: Safety is user-relevant, but the body states no effect the passenger observes (e.g. doors do not close on me, vehicle does not move while doors are open).
user_observable.suggestion: State the observable behaviour, e.g. 'the doors do not close on me and the bus does not move off while I board or leave'.

variant_consistency.reason: Gated by the spelled-out bus condition var.vehicle.type == 'bus'; passenger doors exist only on the bus.
